chunks.title: General Building Code (structural provisions)
chunks.text: SBC 201 — General Building Code (structural provisions). Sets the structural design and safety requirements for buildings in the Kingdom, including load bearing elements. Damage to a load bearing element is a structural condition and is assessed against this code rather than treated as a cosmetic defect.

chunks.title: Electrical requirements
chunks.text: SBC 401 — Electrical requirements. Covers electrical installations, protection and safe enclosure of distribution equipment. An exposed or unsecured panel in an occupied area is a defect under this code.

chunks.title: Fire protection requirements
chunks.text: SBC 801 — Fire protection requirements. Governs means of egress, fire separation and protection systems. Exits must stay usable at all times, so a blocked or locked exit is a life safety failure and not a scheduling matter.

chunks.title: Fire safety requirements for occupied premises
chunks.text: Civil Defence — Fire safety requirements for occupied premises. Sets safety requirements and inspection powers for occupied premises including schools, covering evacuation routes, extinguishers and alarm systems.

chunks.title: School facility specifications and operating procedures
chunks.text: MoE specs — School facility specifications and operating procedures. Defines how school facilities are specified, operated and reported on, and how a principal raises a maintenance request through the ministry chain.

chunks.title: Executing arm for education buildings
chunks.text: TBC mandate — Executing arm for education buildings. Government company owned by the Public Investment Fund that operates as the executing arm for Ministry of Education building projects, covering construction, operation and maintenance of school buildings through a control centre linked to principals and contractors.

chunks.title: Personal Data Protection Law
chunks.text: PDPL — Personal Data Protection Law. Governs the processing of personal data in the Kingdom, including lawful basis, purpose limitation and data minimisation. Photographs taken inside a school may capture students, which brings maintenance imagery into scope.

chunks.title: National data governance and classification
chunks.text: NDMO — National data governance and classification. Sets national rules for data governance, classification and sharing between entities. Classification decides how a dataset may be shared, stored and exposed to third parties.

chunks.title: AI ethics principles
chunks.text: AI Ethics — AI ethics principles. National principles for artificial intelligence covering fairness, transparency, accountability, reliability, privacy and human oversight. They are principles rather than enforceable controls, so they guide design without prescribing an appeal mechanism.

chunks.title: Essential Cybersecurity Controls
chunks.text: ECC-2:2024 — Essential Cybersecurity Controls. The national cybersecurity baseline for government entities and critical infrastructure, covering governance, defence, resilience and third party and cloud security. Access control, logging and supplier obligations sit here.

chunks.title: Cloud cybersecurity controls
chunks.text: CCC-1:2020 — Cloud cybersecurity controls. Controls for cloud service providers and government tenants, including hosting location and separation duties for hosted government data.

chunks.title: Digital government standards; Nafath identity (NIC)
chunks.text: DGA — Digital government standards; Nafath identity (NIC). Standards for government digital services covering interoperability, integration and access. Nafath, the national single sign on operated by the National Information Center under SDAIA (iam.gov.sa), is the identity layer those standards rely on.

chunks.title: Electronic Transactions Law
chunks.auth: Royal Decree M/18 (2007); administered by MCIT
chunks.text: Electronic Transactions Law — Electronic Transactions Law. Gives electronic transactions and electronic signatures legal effect in the Kingdom, and sets when an electronic record and signature carry the same weight as a written one.

chunks.title: National digital certification
chunks.text: Digital certification — National digital certification. Operates the national framework for digital certificates that authenticate the identity behind an electronic signature.

chunks.title: Government tenders and procurement
chunks.text: GTPL / Etimad — Government tenders and procurement. Governs how government entities contract suppliers and how contractual obligations and penalties are applied to them.

chunks.title: Risk management guidelines
chunks.text: ISO 31000 — Risk management guidelines. Guidelines for managing risk, including establishing criteria, evaluating risk by likelihood and consequence, and deciding treatment and escalation.

chunks.title: Information security management
chunks.text: ISO/IEC 27001 — Information security management. Requirements for an information security management system, including controls for logging, access and supplier relationships.

chunks.title: AI management system
chunks.text: ISO/IEC 42001 — AI management system. Requirements for managing artificial intelligence systems across their lifecycle, including impact assessment, documentation and controlled change.

chunks.title: AI risk management guidance
chunks.text: ISO/IEC 23894 — AI risk management guidance. Guidance on applying risk management to artificial intelligence, covering model failure, monitoring and unwanted outcomes.

chunks.title: Architectural framework for machine learning
chunks.text: ITU-T Y.3172 — Architectural framework for machine learning. Defines the machine learning pipeline as a chain of nodes: source, collector, preprocessor, model, policy, distributor and sink, together with the orchestrator that manages them.

chunks.title: Evaluating intelligence levels
chunks.text: ITU-T Y.3173 — Evaluating intelligence levels. A framework for evaluating how much of a task is automated and how much still requires human involvement.

chunks.title: Data handling framework
chunks.text: ITU-T Y.3174 — Data handling framework. A framework for handling data across the machine learning pipeline, including the reference points where data moves between nodes.

chunks.title: Machine learning sandbox
chunks.text: ITU-T Y.3181 — Machine learning sandbox. An architectural framework for a sandbox where a machine learning pipeline is trained and validated in simulation before it is applied to the live system.
